Work

The products, without the theatre.

Four projects. Different levels of maturity. Each one has a constraint that matters more than the logo or the launch announcement.

Mobility / Zimbabwe

LetsGo Ride

A ride platform built for the way people actually move in Zimbabwe.

The constraint

Trust has to be earned before the first trip, while data, older phones and payment habits shape every screen.

The call I made

Keep the flow direct. Make the important actions obvious. Remove anything that slows a rider or driver down.

iOS and Android product · active development

This one has to work
on an ordinary Tuesday.

Consumer / Lifestyle

Navora Brands

A consumer brand trying to look outward without pretending it came from somewhere else.

The constraint

Premium presentation is easy to imitate. A recognisable point of view is harder.

The call I made

Build the visual language before adding categories. Fewer products, clearer identity.

Brand system · retail direction
Fitness / Zimbabwe

DeYon Gym

A gym and member app built around access, routine and a real community.

The constraint

The software has to help the front desk and the member. If either side fights it, it has failed.

The call I made

Start with the unglamorous parts: membership status, entry, check-in and access history.

iOS app · version 1.0
Finance / Europe ↔ Africa

VEYRO

An attempt to make cross-border money movement feel less distant and more understandable.

The constraint

Payments are not a branding exercise. Regulation, partners and trust decide what is possible.

The call I made

Work from the rails backwards. Secure the right partners before making promises to users.

Product concept · partner research

There are no victory-lap numbers here yet.

I would rather show the decisions honestly than manufacture a case study.
